Film Advance Bookings: 'Awarapan 2' Leads Over 'Batwara 1947'

Advance ticket sales for the film 'Awarapan 2' have surpassed those for 'Batwara 1947'. 'Awarapan 2' saw a 171% increase in bookings within 24 hours and is projected to earn four times more than 'Batwara 1947' on its opening day. 'Batwara 1947' has sold 25,000 tickets before its release. Actress Shabana Azmi noted that two films releasing on the same day last occurred in 1983.
